# r2dbc-coroutines-service

Coroutine data-access layer with a bounded suspending connection pool, cancellation-safe transactions, per-call timeouts and a guard that fails blocking calls on event-loop threads.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Problem, usage, and public API summary.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Core component design and SPI.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat model and resource bounds.
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): Coverage and test policies.
